t: A Raspberry Pi robot car with a camera that students code in Python or blocks.
steps: Find the PiCar-X kit and the V2.0 documentation on the SunFounder site.
Get a Raspberry Pi and 18650 batteries, which are often not included.
Assemble the car using the documentation.
Flash an SD card and install the software.
Connect from a phone or computer.
Run a line tracking or obstacle avoidance example.
Leave the online LLM features off until the school has reviewed them.
